national.canonicalTopic: ICGS Meera Behn and ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan decommissioning
national.headline: ICGS Meera Behn and ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan decommissioned
group2: Paper II: Indian Economy, AP Economy, Science & Technology
facts: ICGS Meera Behn and ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan were decommissioned in August 2026 after nearly two decades in service.
Meera Behn (Pennant No. 234) was decommissioned at Okha, Gujarat, on August 22, 2026; Goa Shipyard Limited built the vessel, which was commissioned on July 25, 2006.
Subhadra Kumari Chauhan (Pennant No. 233) was decommissioned in Mumbai on August 27, 2026.
Meera Behn was the original name of Madeleine Slade, a British-born follower of Mahatma Gandhi; Subhadra Kumari Chauhan was a freedom fighter and Hindi poet.
national.summary: Two Coast Guard Fast Patrol Vessels retired after service in maritime security, surveillance and law enforcement.

national.notes:
# 1. What happened
- **What:** **ICGS Meera Behn** and **ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan**, two Coast Guard **Fast Patrol Vessels**, decommissioned in **August 2026** after nearly **two decades** in service.
- **Role:** Maritime security, surveillance and law enforcement.
- **AP link:** No direct **Andhra Pradesh**-specific link established.

# 2. Vessel facts
| Vessel | Decommissioning | Pennant No. | Commissioned / built |
|---|---|---|---|
| **ICGS Meera Behn** | **Okha, Gujarat**, **August 22, 2026** | **234** | Commissioned **July 25, 2006**; built by **Goa Shipyard Limited** |
| **ICGS Subhadra Kumari Chauhan** | **Mumbai**, **August 27, 2026** | **233** | — |
- **Capability:** Fast Patrol Vessels support patrolling, surveillance, interception, search and rescue, and maritime law enforcement [GK].
- ⚠ **Trap:** The vessels had different decommissioning dates and locations: **Meera Behn** at **Okha** on **August 22, 2026**, and **Subhadra Kumari Chauhan** at **Mumbai** on **August 27, 2026**.

# 3. Namesakes
- **Meera Behn:** Original name of **Madeleine Slade**, a **British-born** follower of **Mahatma Gandhi**.
- **Subhadra Kumari Chauhan:** **Freedom fighter** and **Hindi poet**.
> Exam angle: Match each Fast Patrol Vessel with its pennant number, decommissioning place and date.
